question: Show every stadium's name and its number of concerts, sorted by concert count from highest to lowest and then stadium name alphabetically.
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) FROM stadium AS s LEFT JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name ORDER BY COUNT(c.concert_ID) DESC, s.Name ASC
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium AS s
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
    ON c.Stadium_ID = CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
ORDER BY concert_count DESC, s.Name ASC;
